scope: Extend the existing same-revision AC1024 direct-NOD RASTERVARIABLES profile to frame=1, quality=1, units=3, while retaining frame=0. This is a selected-object graph result; it does not qualify native image rendering or complete conversion of the physical source.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.1 and 20.4.91 specify common object references and RASTERVARIABLES BL/BS scalar layout. Autodesk documents DXF frame values 0 and 1 and group meanings at https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2020/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-DDCC21A4-822A-469B-9954-1E1EC4F6DF82.htm .

physical_witness.provenance: Locally authored ezdxf 1.4.5 R2010 DXF with one LINE and raster variables frame=1, quality=1, units=m; ODA File Converter 27.1.0 created the AC1024 DWG and separately converted that DWG back to DXF without .err. No image files or drawing fixtures are added. Fresh authored files can differ because ezdxf records timestamps.
physical_witness.independent_readback: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 reports type 512, handle 0x2F, bit size 72, class/frame/quality/units 0/1/1/3, missing xdictionary and two role-4 handles, owner and reactor to NOD 0xA. ezdxf reads the input and ODA-returned DXFs as AC1024 and observes the same four scalar fields.
physical_witness.source_frame: A hash-bound source-specific probe uses in-tree decompression and frame CRC verification. It walks raster common/scalar fields independently of the typed parser, ending at bit 71; bit 71 is the zero string marker, followed at bit 72 by 16-bit owner role-4 to 0xA and 16-bit reactor role-4 to 0xA. It also parses the NOD and confirms one ACAD_IMAGE_VARS entry to 0x2F. In-tree decomposition, CRC and typed parsing are not independent implementations.
physical_witness.whole_file_limit: The full physical source reads 156/156 frames but has two HEADER integrity observations; strict dwg2dxf export refuses completeness and preserves the existing destination. The CLI used for this diagnostic predates the final adapter relink; its result does not prove or disprove the selected-object output path. Full-source output and physical 0xA to output-NOD mapping remain unqualified.

implementation: Both graph traversal and output preflight accept AC1024 frame 0 or 1 only with existing exact direct-NOD, reactor, missing-XDictionary and 1/3 quality/units gates. A bounded raw-body walker revalidates the scalar value against typed state, source revision, owner/reactor wire roles and padding for AC1024 (and preserves the existing AC1032 0/1/3 profile). Same-revision, source/class capture, unique NOD root entry and all other graph gates remain required.
generated_validation: dwg2dxf_rastervariables_ac1024_frame1_adapter_transport constructs a local DWG with source NOD 0xC and checks RequireComplete ASCII and Binary typed output/readback, source-frame identity, owner/reactor and fields. It tests typed frame 1->0 and 2, quality, units, owner/reactor, xdictionary, root target alias/duplicate/missing, source wire owner/reactor and frame mutations, source wire revision, cross-revision, class and integer failures with destination preservation and same-adapter corrected retry. The AC1024 frame=0 and AC1032 existing selectors remain controls. Both ASCII and Binary use requireResolvedOwners=true.
limits: No broader AC1024 scalar values, alternate owners/reactors, physical full-file strict output, native rendering or downstream application semantics are asserted. Generated source NOD 0xC readback does not establish physical NOD 0xA remapping.

frame0_compatibility.scope: The raw-wire matcher also tightens the previously admitted frame=0 path. Unusual AC1024 frames that lack this exact scalar, typed-handle and zero-padding profile can now fail closed; the existing generated frame=0 control passes. This is a deliberate compatibility narrowing, not a broad producer survey.
frame0_compatibility.result: The exact production matcher accepts the previous ODA-authored physical frame=0 witness after the existing hash/CRC/source probe; mismatched typed frame or parent are rejected. The physical source full-file output remains unqualified.
frame0_compatibility.note: The test-only probe includes dx_iface.cpp to invoke the actual internal matcher, rather than independently duplicating its logic; source extraction and CRC use in-tree routines.

address_sanitizer: The AC1024 frame=0 and frame=1 selectors passed 2/2 with AddressSanitizer for the final matcher; this run preceded the test-only change requiring resolved owners for ASCII. The final strengthened ASCII/Binary owner checks passed in the normal focused run.
